title: Two installs sharing the host's heavy-job slots each get a trial running before either gets a second
description: Two installs' loops share one heavy-jobs directory at limit 2 and submit merge trials while another job holds both slots, the first install's three trials queued ahead of the second's two; when the slots free, one trial from each install starts before either runs a second at once, master status heavyJobs lists holders from both projects, and every trial runs without any job being stopped (GY-3487).

steps.name: both installs' trials start before either runs a second at once
